items.title: Light wash denim trucker jacket
items.description: Classic light blue denim jacket with two flap chest pockets and metal shank buttons. Some natural fading on the sleeves. Fits like a women's M.

items.title: Olive cotton chore coat
items.description: Workwear style chore coat in washed olive brown cotton. Notched collar, patch pockets on the front. Relaxed boxy fit, worn a handful of times.

items.title: Grey canvas work jacket with orange lining
items.description: Heavy grey canvas work jacket, snap front, chest and hand pockets, bright orange lining. Rugged workwear piece, good for autumn.
items.source: File:A Carhartt work jacket with grey fabric.png (Wikimedia Commons), CC BY-SA 4.0

items.title: Teal and mustard plaid flannel shirt
items.description: Soft wool-blend flannel overshirt in a teal, mustard and grey plaid. Two lower patch pockets, snap buttons. Can be layered as a light jacket.
items.source: File:Flannel Shirt For Abi.jpg (Wikimedia Commons), CC BY-SA 2.0

items.title: Red ribbed knit cardigan
items.description: Bright red rib knit cardigan with a small collar and seven buttons. Stretchy and cozy, no pilling that I can see.

items.title: Washed black flame graphic hoodie
items.description: Faded black pullover hoodie with a flame logo print on the chest and star graphics on both sleeves. Kangaroo pocket. Streetwear vibe.

items.title: Olive military cargo pants
items.description: Vintage army style cargo pants in olive green cotton ripstop. Big bellows side pockets, adjustable waist tabs. Hem is a little frayed.

items.title: Khaki multi-pocket cargo pants
items.description: Sand khaki cotton cargo pants with flap pockets on the thighs and calves. Utility workwear look. Barely worn.
items.source: File:Khaki Cargo Pants Side.jpg (Wikimedia Commons), CC BY-SA 4.0

items.title: Distressed leather rider jacket
items.description: Dark brown leather jacket with a stand collar, zip front and zip chest pocket. Nicely broken in with creasing on the sleeves.

items.title: Beige nylon hooded shell jacket
items.description: Lightweight nylon rain shell in beige with a hood, zip and snap placket and hand pockets. Packable, good for spring.
items.source: File:Windbreaker Jacket, Hood Outside.jpg (Wikimedia Commons), public domain

items.title: Color block nylon windbreaker
items.description: 90s style green nylon windbreaker with red and blue color block panels. Full zip, elastic cuffs and hem.
items.source: File:Polo Ralph Lauren color block Windbreaker jacket.jpg (Wikimedia Commons), CC BY 2.0

items.title: Navy striped canvas tote bag
items.description: Sturdy cotton canvas tote with navy and cream stripes and navy handles. Fits a laptop and a sweater.
items.source: File:Canvas two-tone tote Navy and Natural7 (9038437258).jpg (Wikimedia Commons), CC BY 2.0
